1879072554.name: Quit Whining and Fight!
1879072554.desc: Exhort and deride your allies, restoring some of their health. Heals all allies within radius.

1879090218.name: Crush
1879090218.desc: Crush little annoying things. Sometimes, stun them. Sometimes, make them hurt long time.

1879096874.name: Feral Strike
1879096874.desc: Your companion lashes out with an extremely damaging strike, cleaving multiple enemies with its claws.

1879109290.name: Prelude to Hope
1879109290.desc: Heals the target +2% per Healing attunement.

1879110954.name: Wild Strike
1879110954.desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879134762.name: Stealthed Ambush
1879134762.desc: When attacking from stealth, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879241642.name: Coda of the Eorlingas
1879241642.desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a powerful and effective heal for you and up to eight friendly targets nearby.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879252266.name: Quick Sting
1879252266.desc: Frodo wields Sting, the blade given to him by Bilbo, and can use it to quickly strike an enemy.

1879266858.name: Love of the Shire
1879266858.desc: Halros travelled south with the Grey Company, but his memories of that happy land can restore his morale and restore his Vitality.

1879272490.name: Dodge This!
1879272490.desc: A javelin throw which cannot be avoided.\n\nThis skill is only available after an enemy avoids one of your attacks.

1879289386.name: Diminished Target
1879289386.desc: Attack and weaken the tactical defences of your foes.

1879319978.name: Dash
1879319978.desc: Your steed pushes itself beyond normal limits, increasing its speed for a short period of time.

1879333290.name: Muster in the War-stead
1879333290.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Rohirrim War-stead.

1879387306.name: Goat of the Moria Sentinel
1879387306.desc: A goat employed in the protection of Moria.

1879388586.name: Sapphire Neekerbreeker
1879388586.desc: Brings out a sapphire Neekerbreeker to keep you company.

1879411754.name: Wild Spotted Donkey
1879411754.desc: Summons a loveable wild donkey travelling companion.

1879415850.name: Call Marigold
1879415850.desc: Blow the horn to summon Marigold to your side.

1879424426.name: Joy of Battle - Damage
1879424426.desc: For a short duration, any strikes you make will build your fighting spirit, increasing your damage. Gain a stacking damage buff with each attack skill you use, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.\n\nUsing one 'Joy of Battle' skill will trigger the cooldown for both 'Joy of Battle' skills.

1879454890.name: Guide to Swanfleet
1879454890.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Lhan Garan in Swanfleet.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879508650.name: Striped Deep-claw Whelp
1879508650.desc: Summons a striped deep-claw whelp to accompany you on your travels.

1879516458.name: Focus
1879516458.desc: You steel your resolve and focus, breaking free of any negative combat state.
